description.zh:
业务类型
取值：
    FREEZE：用户冻结业务
    TRUSTEESHIP：用户托管业务
description.en: The type of the business. Valid values: FREEZE: the frozen business of the account. TRUSTEESHIP: the hosted business of the account.

description.zh:
需要设置的用户状态
取值：
    Freeze：用户冻结状态
    Thaw：用户解冻状态
    Trusteeship：用户托管状态
    TrusteeshipCancel：用户非托管状态
description.en: The account status that you want to set. Valid values: Freeze: The account is frozen. Thaw: The account is unfrozen. Trusteeship: The account is hosted. TrusteeshipCancel: The account is not hosted.

description.zh:
停机模式
取值：
    0：普通停机
    1：立即停机
description.en:
停机模式
取值：
    0：普通停机
    1：立即停机

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi set-reseller-user-status --status Freeze --business-type FREEZE --stop-mode 0 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi SetResellerUserStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status Freeze --BusinessType FREEZE --StopMode 0
